Visual Basic Script (VBScript) is a Windows-specific language used by systems administrators and web developers. Although VBScript was very popular in previous versions of Windows, it has been mostly replaced by PowerShell and is not gradually replacing batch files.

Python is a high-level, general-purpose programming language with a focus on code readability. Python is used extensively with large data sets and is very popular with the scientific community. However, this language is not gradually replacing batch files.

questionBank.stem:
Analyze the script below.

10 #! /bin/bash
20 echo "Bash version ${Bash_Version}..."
30 for i in {0..10..2}
40 do
50   echo "Welcome $i times"
60 done

This is an example of which of the following script languages?
questionBank.explanation:
This is an example of a shell script. Line 10 identifies the script as a BASH shell script.

Python scripts will begin with a #!, like line 10, but will also include which interpreter should be used.

Command scripts begin by listing the commands that need to be executed.

A distribution refers to the name of version of the Linux operating system, is Red Hate or Elementary OS.

questionBank.stem:
A user is reviewing a script and comes across the code in one of the lines as follows. What is the line doing?

#until ping -c1 "$1" &>/dev/null
questionBank.explanation: A comment line is indicated by a special delimiter. In Bash and several other languages, the comment delimiter is the hash or pound sign (#). In Bash, the values $1, $2, and so on are used to refer to arguments by position (the order in which they are entered when executing the script). A loop allows a statement block to be repeated based on some type of condition. The &>/dev/null part stops the usual ping output from being written to the terminal by redirecting it to a null device.
options: Prevent from writing to the terminal.

questionBank.stem: Which of the following scripting languages includes multiple Windows commands that are run in sequence?
questionBank.explanation:
Although not technically a scripting language, batch files (.bat) include multiple Windows commands, which are executed in sequence.

JavaScript is used widely for website and web page design, but is not based on Windows commands.

In the Linux and Unix world, the most popular method of scripting is shell scripting. Shell scripts are not based on Windows commands.

Python is a high-level, general-purpose programming language with a focus on code readability. Python is used extensively with large data sets and is very popular with the scientific community. However, this language is not based on Windows commands.

questionBank.stem: A penetration tester wants to perform drive mapping on an engagement on a Windows-based OS but suspects that the security is monitoring PowerShell commands. What could the tester use to map a network drive while remaining unnoticed?
questionBank.explanation: In a Windows batch file, the net use command performs drive mapping. Network drive mapping is a Windows-only concept. Mapping a drive can be done using PowerShell using the New-PSDrive cmdlet. This demonstrates the need for error handling. If users try to map a drive using a letter that has been assigned already, the script will return an error. In Linux, a file system is made available by mounting it within the root file system using the mount and umount commands. Using the echo command simply outputs something specified to the terminal.

questionBank.stem:
Analyze the below PowerShell script.

10 echo "This computer's name is $env:COMPUTERNAME" `n
20 echo "Operating System Information"
30 Get-ComputerInfo OsName, OsVersion, OsBuildNumber`
40 echo "Processor Information"
50 Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_Processor | Select-Object -ExcludeProperty "CIM*" `
60 echo "Installed Memory in GB"
70 (Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_PhysicalMemory | Measure-Object -Property capacity -Sum).sum /1gb
80 Restart-Computer -force -Wait 240

What does "$env" mean in line 10?
questionBank.explanation:
The $env refers to environmental variables. In this case, it will pull the computer's name environmental variable and include it in the statement "This computer's name is..."

The PowerShell environment is called using the file extension .ps1.

The $env does not change the computer name or ask for the user to provide a computer name.
options: It changes the computer name to $env.
It asks the user for the computer name.
It refers to an environmental variable.
correctAnswer: It refers to an environmental variable.

questionBank.stem:
Analyze the script below.

10 #! /bin/bash
20 echo "Bash version ${Bash_Version}..."
30 for i in {0..10..2}
40 do
50   echo "Welcome $i times"
60 done

Line 30 is an example of which of the following?
questionBank.explanation:
A for loop is shown by line 30. A loop evaluates a given condition and then continues to repeat until the specified condition is reached. In this case it will repeat the echoed statement a number of times until it reaches the end of the list. A variable is a defined item that stores a value that may be changed during the execution of the script. A constant is a defined item that stores a value that may not be changed during the execution of the script.

A branch is an instruction to execute a different sequence of instructions based on the outcome of some logical test.

questionBank.stem:
As a network administrator for several hundred machines, you have been given the task of listing all workstations and servers in your company network that have less than 16 GB of RAM.

What is the BEST method for accurately collecting this data?
questionBank.explanation:
With a good script, you could run a query of all machines that have less than 16 GB of RAM, compile a list of the query results, and then return the list when it finishes. That way, instead of connecting to each machine remotely and checking manually, you can perform the task in much less time.

Sending an email request or checking the IT records for each machine can take days or weeks, and this might not accurately represent the machines' current RAM states.
options: Send out an email requesting the information.
Use a script to run a query of all machines.
correctAnswer: Use a script to run a query of all machines.

questionBank.stem: Which of the following BEST describes a scripting language?
questionBank.explanation:
Scripting languages are interpreted programming languages used to write scripts, generally in a human-readable format.

Scripting is the process of organizing commands and structures into a script.

Scripts are text files with commands and structures specific to a scripting language.

Shell scripting (in the Linux and Unix world) is a popular method of scripting based on the Bourne shell.
options: A popular method of scripting based on the Bourne shell
The process of organizing commands and structures into a script
An interpreted programming language used to write scripts
A text file with commands and structures
correctAnswer: An interpreted programming language used to write scripts

questionBank.stem: Which of the following are common uses for scripting? (Select three.)
questionBank.explanation:
Common uses for scripting include:
- Network drive remapping
- Automated backups
- System updates

While automating email mass mailings, creating scripts, and managing bookmark lists could all be impacted by scripting, there are other methods and utilities that are more efficient and commonly used for these tasks.

questionBank.stem: What is the most commonly used file extension for a shell script?
questionBank.explanation:
The most commonly used file extension for a shell script is .sh.

In terms of shell scripts, bash, ksh, and zsh all refer to forms of shell scripting (Bourne Again shell, Korn shell, and Z shell).

questionBank.stem: Which of the following forms of shell scripting is most commonly used?
questionBank.explanation:
Although there are several languages that fall under the term "shell scripting," the most commonly used form of shell scripting on Unix & Linux is the Bourne Again (Bash).

The Bourne Again shell (Bash), Korn shell (ksh), and Z shell (Zsh) each have their own syntax variations directly related to the Bourne shell.

questionBank.stem: Which of the following are characteristics specific to the Python programming language? (Select two.)
questionBank.explanation:
Python is a high-level, general-purpose programming language with a focus on code readability. Python is used extensively with large data sets and is very popular with the scientific community.

In the Linux and Unix world, the most popular method of scripting is shell scripting.

Although not technically a scripting language, batch files (.bat) can collect multiple Windows commands and execute them in sequence.

JavaScript is used widely for website and web page design.
options: Most popular method of scripting in the Linux world
Executes multiple Windows commands in sequence
Used for website and web page design

questionBank.stem: Which scripting language is widely used for website and web page design and is also the most popular programming language in the world?
questionBank.explanation:
JavaScript is widely used for website and web page design and is also the most popular programming language in the world.

Although not technically a scripting language, batch files (.bat) can collect multiple Windows commands and execute them in turn.

Python is a high-level, general-purpose programming language with a focus on code readability. Python is used extensively with large data sets and is very popular with the scientific community.

Visual Basic (VBScript) is a Windows-specific language used by systems administrators and web developers. Although VBScript was very popular in previous versions of Windows, it has been mostly replaced by PowerShell.

questionBank.stem: A security engineer wants to learn how to code in Python but is running a Windows box. Which of the following is the easiest interpreter to set up for Windows?
questionBank.explanation:
CPython is the simplest environment to set up for Windows. When using CPython in Windows, there is a console interpreter (python.exe) and a windowed interpreter (pythonw.exe). A Python project can either be run via an interpreter or compiled as a binary executable.

Pypy is another interpreter that will work, but CPython is easier to set up.

The Windows Script Host (wscript.exe and cscript.exe) supports JavaScript but not Python. JavaScript is also supported on macOS for automation (along with AppleScript). Cscript.exe does not support Python either. Python script files are identified by the .PY extension.

questionBank.stem: When reviewing a change request, where would a manager look to find the number of devices, users, or customers affected by the change?
questionBank.explanation:
The scope is the number of devices, users, or customers affected by the change. The scope can also include costs, timescales, and potentially subtasks or stakeholders. The scope should also include the factors that determine the success or failure of the change.

The purpose of the change is to make the change and the benefits that the change will accrue.

In the IT Infrastructure Library (ITIL) Configuration Management Model, service assets are things, processes, or people that contribute to delivering an IT service.

In the IT Infrastructure Library (ITIL) Configuration Management Model, performance baselines are metrics for expected performance to provide a basis for comparison for ongoing monitoring of a change.

questionBank.stem: What must be disconnected first whenever a technician adds or replaces components within a PC or laptop?
questionBank.explanation:
Whenever the technician adds or replaces components within a PC or laptop, they must disconnect the power first. Remove the AC plug and remove the battery, if present.

Electrostatic discharge (ESD) straps are straps that can be worn on a technician's wrist or ankles to dissipate static charges more effectively. This helps ensure both the safety of the technician and the equipment.

Capacitors are devices designed to store electrical energy. Charges held in power supply capacitors can persist for hours after turning off the power. Do not open a power supply unless trained to do so.

Damaged components or cables are an electrical shock risk and should be replaced or isolated immediately after removing power from the device.

questionBank.stem: It can be difficult for employees to adjust to a new or upgraded software. As well as the technical implementation, what must the change plan account for to mitigate this?
questionBank.explanation:
As well as the technical implementation, the change plan must account for end-user acceptance. It can be difficult for people to adapt to new processes and easy for them to magnify minor problems.

During a major change process, end-users may perform testing of the software or hardware to verify it functions properly and recommend changes, if necessary. This process is called user-acceptance testing (UAT). Users may conduct this in a production environment.

Risk mitigation is an important part of the risk management process. It involves creating steps to lower initial risk to an acceptable level.

Sandbox testing is the process of testing a change in a computing environment designed to replicate the production environment but isolated from it.

questionBank.stem: The double pipe symbol is used as which conditional operator?
questionBank.explanation:
The double pipes || are used as an OR operator in scripting.

XOR operations use the caret ^ symbol and are used for bitwise XOR operations.

AND use the && in symbol notation.

Equals is represented by == in scripting.

questionBank.stem: A technician runs an isolated test that allows them to run the program without impacting the system. What is this called?
questionBank.explanation:
Sandbox testing is a computing environment designed to replicate the production environment but isolated from it.

End-user acceptance must be accounted for when a change of plan is implemented. It can be difficult for people to adapt to new processes and easy for them to magnify minor problems into major complaints.

A rollback plan is when a change can be reversed if it has harmful or unforeseen consequences.

Affected systems must be considered in the implementation of change. Companies should first attempt to test the change for the most significant or major changes.

questionBank.stem: An .exe file is initiated on a Windows system and is running in silent mode. What technique is being performed in this instance?
questionBank.explanation:
Installation of applications is used in Windows as a setup file that can be executed in silent mode using the command switches for its installer. In Linux, scripts are often used to compile apps from source code.

In Windows Power, hundreds of Get verb cmdlets gather information/data from a Windows subsystem. Bash supports numerous commands to manipulate text.

The initiation of updates takes place through wusa.exe in Windows, which processes batch files to initiate a typical update.

The PSWindowsUpdate module in PowerShell contains numerous cmdlets. Users can use apt.get/apt or yum from a Bash script in Linux.

questionBank.stem: An engineer is looking for methods that protect the organization's computers and network. What comes in adapters, trailing sockets, or filter plugs, with the protection circuitry built into the unit?
questionBank.explanation:
The simplest surge suppressor devices come in adapters, trailing sockets, or filter plugs, with the protection circuitry built into the unit.

Sudden power loss is likely to cause file corruption. If a loss of power occurs, system operation can sustain for a few minutes by using battery backup and can be provisioned at the component level for disk drives, RAID arrays, and memory modules.

Technicians can often use PC-safe vacuums to blow air and suction so that they can replace the need for compressed air canisters.

The location of computer equipment placement can affect its proper operation and lifespan. Users should keep all electronic equipment away from extremes of temperature and damp or dusty conditions.

questionBank.stem: While reviewing system logs during troubleshooting a laptop, it becomes apparent that one of the small-outline DIMM (SODIMM) memory cards needs replacing. What is the first step a technician must do to replace the memory?
questionBank.explanation:
Whenever the technician adds or replaces components within a PC or laptop, they must disconnect the power first. Remove the AC plug and remove the battery, if present.

Electrostatic discharge (ESD) straps are straps that can be worn on a technician's wrist or ankles to dissipate static charges more effectively. This helps ensure both the safety of the technician and the equipment.

Capacitors are devices designed to store electrical energy. Charges held in power supply capacitors can persist for hours after turning off the power. Do not open a power supply unless trained to do so.

Damaged components or cables are an electrical shock risk and should be replaced or isolated immediately after removing power from the device.
options: Disconnect power before repairing the PC.
correctAnswer: Disconnect power before repairing the PC.

questionBank.stem: If necessary, technicians should wear protective clothing for handling equipment and materials that can be hazardous. Which of the following is safety gear worn to minimize any risk of burns from corrosive materials or eye irritation from particles, such as toner or dust?
questionBank.explanation:
Use safety goggles and gloves to minimize any risk of burns from corrosive materials from broken batteries, cell phones, and tablets or irritation from particles, such as toner or dust.

An air filter mask that fits over the mouth and nose is a recommended face covering when working with compressed air, toner spills, or working in a dusty environment. An air filter mask will not protect the eyes.

Electrostatic discharge (ESD) straps are straps that can be worn on the wrist or ankles of a technician to dissipate static charges more effectively.

Office carts are good for helping individuals transfer items from one location to another. They do not protect from airborne particles such as toner or dust.

questionBank.stem: Square brackets [ ] are commonly used to establish what in a Bash script?
questionBank.explanation: The square brackets are used to establish a test case for the script. These are commonly seen as part of branches. They are not used to set variables, set up an array, or used for comments.

questionBank.stem: You are filling out a change order form. Toward its end, you explain how you will return affected hardware and software to its original state if the change fails. What is this plan called?
questionBank.explanation:
A rollback plan is the portion of a change order form that details how you will return affected hardware and software to its original state if the proposed change fails.

A risk analysis is the portion of a change order form that details the risks of the proposed change and presents a plan for mitigating them.

A backup plan is the use of a system backup file in order to restore the system state to when the backup was completed.

A system image backs up all data on a drive volume.

questionBank.stem: A cyber architect reviews the organization's current and future state design for automation and scripting. When is it appropriate to use the Bash command shutdown -r?
questionBank.explanation:
No operating system (OS) would ever need restarting in an ideal world. Linux is famous for its ability to run for any period without requiring a restart. However, should the need arise, the command to restart the host in Bash is shutdown -r.

In a Windows batch file, the net use command performs drive mapping. The same thing can be done with PowerShell using the New-PSDrive cmdlet.

In Windows, a technician can execute a setup file in silent mode by using the command switches for its installer.

In Windows, the wusa.exe process can be called from a batch file to perform typical update tasks. In PowerShell, the PSWindowsUpdate module contains numerous cmdlets for managing the update process.

questionBank.stem: Which of the following would a technician use to protect static-sensitive components during storage or travel?
questionBank.explanation:
Antistatic bags reduce electrostatic discharge (ESD) risk because of their conductive material coating. This material prevents static electricity from discharging through the inside of the bag.

Technicians use dissipative packaging for packaging non-static-sensitive components packed in proximity to static-sensitive components.

An electrostatic discharge (ESD) mat is a mat that is used as a place to organize sensitive components. The mats contain a snap connected to the wrist or leg strap. The mat may self-ground or attach to a grounding point.

Surge suppressor devices are adapters, trailing sockets, or filter plugs with the protection circuitry built into the unit. They prevent electrical surges but do not protect against electrostatic discharge.

questionBank.stem: A technician is reviewing the team's guidelines on scripting. What is a tenet of basic automation?
questionBank.explanation:
One of the primary use cases for scripting is basic automation. Automation means performing some series of tasks supported by an operating system (OS) or by an app via a script rather than manually.

In Windows, a technician can execute a setup file in silent mode by using the command switches for its installer.

A technician can perform a simple backup using the ordinary file-copy tools at the command prompt. A technician can set the script to run automatically using Windows Task Scheduler or via cron in Linux.

In Windows, the wusa.exe process can be called from a batch file to perform typical update tasks. In PowerShell, the PSWindowsUpdate module contains numerous cmdlets for managing the update process.
options: It can be executed in silent mode by using the command switches for its installer.
It is one of the primary use cases for scripting.
It can be set to initiate on its own by using Windows Task Scheduler.
It can be called from a batch file to perform typical update tasks.
correctAnswer: It is one of the primary use cases for scripting.

questionBank.stem: ESD is most likely to occur in which of the following environments?
questionBank.explanation:
Electrostatic discharge (ESD) is most likely to occur in a cool, dry atmosphere.

A warm and humid atmosphere helps dissipate the buildup of static electricity, so ESD is less likely to occur.

questionBank.stem: Which of the following devices come in the form of adapters, trailing sockets, or filter plugs, with the protection circuitry built into the unit?
questionBank.explanation:
Surge suppressors are passive protection devices that can filter out the effects of surges and spikes.

A compressed air blaster can be used to dislodge dust from difficult-to-reach areas. When performing this sort of maintenance within a controlled area, wear an appropriate air-filter mask and goggles.

Antistatic bags are packages that reduce the risk of ESD because it is coated with a conductive material.

Anti-ESD wrist straps should fit snugly around the wrist or ankle so that the metal stud makes contact with the skin. Wearing an anti-ESD wrist strap causes the static charge to dissipate more effectively.

questionBank.stem: What phase of the procurement life cycle includes the documentation of an asset, such as warranty and licensing details?
questionBank.explanation:
The procurement phase of the asset procurement life cycle is the process of determining the available budget and identifying a trusted vendor or supplier.

The deployment phase of the procurement life cycle is when a technician implements a controlled procedure to install software or hardware assets in a secure configuration.

Change management procedures approve a request for a new or upgraded asset, taking account of impacts to business, operations, networks, and existing devices.

The technician implements the maintenance phase of the procurement life cycle to monitor and support the use of an asset.

questionBank.stem: A Windows administrator is combing through server logs and sees that a wscript.exe executed a script. What type of script is executed by default?
questionBank.explanation: VBScript files are identified by the .VBS extension. VBScript is executed by the wscript.exe interpreter by default. A shell script written for the basic Windows CMD interpreter is often described as a batch file. Batch files use the .BAT extension. Microsoft provides the Windows PowerShell Integrated Scripting Environment (ISE) for rapid development. PowerShell script files are identified by the .PS1 extension. A Linux shell script is a file that contains a list of commands to be read and executed by the shell. Every shell script starts with a line that designates the interpreter.

questionBank.stem:
To improve the safety of your location and comply with regulations regarding work environments with hazardous materials, you have been assigned to assemble Material Safety Data Sheets (MSDS) for all chemicals used in your shop.

How should you obtain these documents?
questionBank.explanation:
Material Safety Data Sheets (MSDS) are written and distributed by chemical manufacturers. You can download them from the manufacturer's website or request them from a company representative.

MSDS sheets contain information that is only available from the manufacturer. Neither your manager nor a workers' safety insurance office can provide MSDS documents. Attempting to write your own MSDS sheet can be dangerous, as you do not have all the critical information necessary that is available from the manufacturer.
options: Write them yourself after researching the issues.
Download them from the chemical manufacturer's websites.
Get them from your local workers' safety insurance office.
correctAnswer: Download them from the chemical manufacturer's websites.

questionBank.stem:
As a systems engineer for a large retail corporation, you have filled out a change order form to replace the laptop computers that sales reps use on the road with business tablets that are much more durable, provide both touch and keyboard options, and are more portable and easier to use when working with clients.

The request has been forwarded to the change board, which is reviewing the change order form with you. One of the board members asks if this change will impact plans to move more of the business online to reach customers directly.

Which of the following questions does the board member really want answered?
questionBank.explanation:
What the board member really wants to know is how the requested change will fit with the company's strategic focus to move business online.

The scope, deliverables, and desired outcomes are also questions that the board will want to know more about, but they do not relate to the strategic focus change of moving online.
options: What is the scope of the requested change?
How does this change fit with the company's current strategic focus?
correctAnswer: How does this change fit with the company's current strategic focus?

questionBank.stem: A user uses a scripting language based on Microsoft's Visual Basic programming language. Which of the following extensions is used?
questionBank.explanation:
.vbs is the VBScript file extension. VBScript predates PowerShell. The wscript.exe interpreter executes VBScript by default.

.bat is the Windows batch file extension. A shell script for the basic Windows CMD interpreter is often described as a batch file.

.js is the JavaScript file extension. JavaScript is a scripting language designed to implement interactive web-based content and web applications. Most web servers and browsers are configured with a JavaScript interpreter.

.py is the Python file extension. Python is a general-purpose scripting and programming language that can develop both automation scripts and software applications.

questionBank.stem: A project with significant impact should incorporate testing to allow end-users to work with the updated system and suggest improvements before release. What is this process called?
questionBank.explanation:
During a major change process, end-users may perform testing of the software or hardware to verify it functions properly and recommend changes, if necessary. This process is called user-acceptance testing (UAT).

Training and education for end-users is a critical part of the change management process. Software manuals and resources need to be available to the end-user before implementing a change in the production environment.

Risk mitigation is an important part of the risk management process. It involves creating steps to lower initial risk to an acceptable level.

Sandbox testing is the process of testing a change in a computing environment designed to replicate the production environment but isolated from it.

questionBank.stem:
You are a technician at a mid-sized company that recently implemented a Configuration Management Database (CMDB) to track its IT assets.

While troubleshooting a network issue, you need to verify the specifications of a server to determine if it meets the requirements for a new application deployment.

Which of the following actions should you take using the CMDB?
questionBank.explanation:
The CMDB is designed to store detailed information about assets, such as specifications, asset IDs, and lifecycle data. Searching for the server's asset ID allows you to access the stored specifications and determine if the server meets the requirements for the new application.

Creating a new entry is unnecessary if the server is already tracked in the CMDB. This action could lead to duplicate records and confusion.

While maintaining accurate records is important, deleting outdated entries is unrelated to troubleshooting or verifying the server's specifications.

Asset IDs are typically assigned during the procurement process and should not be changed arbitrarily, as this could disrupt tracking and documentation.
options: Use the CMDB to assign a new asset ID to the server for better tracking.
Search for the server's asset ID and review its specifications in the CMDB.
Delete outdated entries in the CMDB to ensure only current assets are listed.
Create a new entry in the CMDB for the server to document its specifications.
correctAnswer: Search for the server's asset ID and review its specifications in the CMDB.

questionBank.stem: A technician is creating a playbook for Windows-based script file extensions. What file extension/scripting language based on Microsoft's Visual Basic programming language predates PowerShell?
questionBank.explanation:
VBScript is a scripting language based on Microsoft's Visual Basic programming language and predates PowerShell. VBScript files are identified by the .VBS extension.

Microsoft provides the Windows PowerShell Integrated Scripting Environment (ISE) for rapid development. PowerShell script files are identified by the .PS1 extension.

A shell script written for the basic Windows CMD interpreter is a batch file. Batch files use the .BAT extension.

A Linux shell script uses the .SH extension by convention. Every shell script starts with a shebang line that designates which interpreter to use, such as Bash or Ksh.

questionBank.stem: A department coder adds various script commands to the organization's coding playbook. What starts with a shebang line designating which interpreter to use, such as Bash or Ksh?
questionBank.explanation:
A Linux shell script uses the .SH extension by convention. Every shell script starts with a shebang line that designates which interpreter to use, such as Bash or Ksh.

Microsoft provides the Windows PowerShell Integrated Scripting Environment (ISE) for rapid development. PowerShell script files are identified by the .PS1 extension.

A shell script written for the basic Windows CMD interpreter is a batch file. Batch files use the .BAT extension.

VBScript is a scripting language based on Microsoft's Visual Basic programming language and predates PowerShell. VBScript files are identified by the .VBS extension.

questionBank.stem:
Your company provides testing services that help customers identify and resolve performance issues with their software and e-commerce sites before they go live. To perform accurate testing, a large number of computers are required, sometimes numbering in the hundreds.

Recently, you have noticed that the lights in the testing lab seem dimmer than normal and sometimes flicker.

Which of the following electrical terms BEST describes the condition you are most likely experiencing?
questionBank.explanation:
The dimming or flickering is most likely caused by a drop in the voltage to the lab due to the large number of computers being run at the same time. This drop in voltage is known as an under-voltage event and can be harmful to your computers. You should take steps to maintain a constant level of electricity.

Power surges (also called power spikes) are abnormally high voltages that last for short periods of time. These can also be harmful to your computers.

A power failure is a total loss of power.

A power spike is like a power surge, but it lasts for milliseconds instead of seconds.

questionBank.stem: Which of the following is a best practice lifting technique when lifting an object?
questionBank.explanation:
Lifting a heavy object in the wrong way can damage the back or cause muscle strains and ligament damage. Incorrectly lifting also increases the risk of dropping, causing injury to the technician and the object. Bend both knees to reach the object while keeping the back as straight as possible and comfortable.

Do not bend over at the waist. Lifting in this manner could damage the back or leave the load misbalanced.

Do not keep both feet together. Plant both feet around the object with one foot slightly toward the direction the object will move to.

Find a firm grip on the object, then lift smoothly by straightening both legs—do not jerk the object up.

questionBank.stem: What process involves testing a change in a computing environment designed to replicate the production environment but isolated from it?
questionBank.explanation:
Sandbox testing is the process of testing a change in a computing environment designed to replicate the production environment but isolated from it.

The change plan must account for end-user acceptance. It can be difficult for people to adapt to new processes and easy for them to magnify minor problems.

During a major change process, end-users may perform testing of the software or hardware to verify it functions properly and recommend changes, if necessary. This process is called user-acceptance testing (UAT). The user may conduct this in a production environment.

Risk mitigation is an important part of the risk management process. It involves creating steps to lower initial risk to an acceptable level.

questionBank.stem: If a fault causes metal parts in the equipment to become live, what provides a path of least resistance for the electrical current to flow away harmlessly?
questionBank.explanation:
A ground provides a path of least resistance for the electrical current to flow away harmlessly. Small electrical devices connect to the building ground via the power plug. Large equipment racks must be grounded as well.

An electrical device has a fuse appropriate to its maximum current. If the current increases past the fuse capacity, the fuse will blow. However, if the fuse fitted is rated too low, the fuse will blow too easily.

A power supply unit provides power to the electrical device. Fuses in the power supply unit blow when the current increases past the fuse capacity.

Capacitors are devices designed to store electrical energy. Charges held in capacitors can persist for hours after turning off the power.

questionBank.stem: A technician evaluates the impacts associated with handling certain materials within the workplace. What item must be collected by using an approved vacuum and sealed within a strong plastic waste container?
questionBank.explanation:
Photocopier and laser-printer toner is an extremely fine powder. Loose toner must be collected carefully by using an approved toner vacuum and sealed within a strong plastic waste container.

Swollen or leaking batteries from laptop computers or within cell phones and tablets must be handled very carefully and stored within appropriate containers but do not require the use of a vacuum.

Display screens are categorized as part of "other device and asset disposal" but do not require the use of an approved vacuum for disposal.

Mobile devices are categorized the same as display screens and do not need a vacuum for disposal.

questionBank.stem:
Analyze the below PowerShell script.

10 echo "This computer's name is $env:COMPUTERNAME" `n
20 echo "Operating System Information"
30 Get-ComputerInfo OsName, OsVersion, OsBuildNumber`
40 echo "Processor Information"
50 Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_Processor | Select-Object -ExcludeProperty "CIM*" `
60 echo "Installed Memory in GB"
70 (Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_PhysicalMemory | Measure-Object -Property capacity -Sum).sum /1gb
80 Restart-Computer -Force

What does line 80 accomplish?
questionBank.explanation:
The Restart-Computer cmdlet with the -Force parameter means to restart the system immediately and does not require the user to confirm.

There is no waiting or confirmation required under the -Force parameter of the Restart-Computer cmdlet. To specify a computer name, you would need to use the -ComputerName parameter.
options: Waits for the computer to stop processing the Force application, then restarts
Restarts the computer and enforces a user confirmation

questionBank.stem:
A technical support representative gets assigned a new ticket. While reviewing the ticket system, the representative needs to look up the user's contact details.

Where is this type of information typically located?
questionBank.explanation:
The user's name and contact details, plus other relevant information, such as department or job role, are stored in the user information section of the support ticket.

Device information is the data recorded in the ticketing system specific to the user's device.

The support technician will enter a description of the issue at hand into a user ticket. Support technicians can use this information to narrow the problem field and track a history of related problems to one or more systems.

The technician can link the employee database to the ticketing system to enter user information quickly.

questionBank.stem: Why is it important to establish and test a theory during the troubleshooting process?
questionBank.explanation:
Establishing and testing a theory is a systematic approach to diagnosing a problem. By identifying probable causes and confirming them through testing, technicians can determine the root cause and proceed with an appropriate solution.

It is important to diagnose the problem before implementing a solution. Skipping this step before implementing a solution can lead to incorrect fixes and wasted effort.

It is also important to go beyond symptoms and identify the underlying causes of the problem. Focusing only on symptoms without testing theories encourages wasting time on incomplete solutions.

The troubleshooting process encourages using research methods, consulting other technicians, and leveraging external resources when necessary. Collaboration and research are valuable tools for accurately diagnosing and resolving issues.
options: To systematically identify the probable cause of the problem and confirm it through testing.
To focus solely on the symptoms of the problem without considering possible causes.
To avoid consulting external resources or other technicians during the troubleshooting process.
To immediately implement a solution without wasting time on unnecessary steps.
correctAnswer: To systematically identify the probable cause of the problem and confirm it through testing.

questionBank.stem: Which of the following is a feature of the Windows 11 desktop that differentiates it from the Windows 10 desktop?
questionBank.explanation:
Windows 11 introduced a rather aligned taskbar as part of its refreshed desktop style. This is a key feature that differentiates Windows 11 from Windows 10.

The touch-optimized Start menu is a feature of Windows 10, not Windows 11. Windows 11 uses a touch-optimized Start menu interface.

The notification area containing icons for background processes is a standard feature of both Windows 10 and Windows 11. It is not unique to Windows 11 and, therefore, does not differentiate the two versions.

Having shortcut icons on the desktop is a standard feature of both Windows 10 and Windows 11. It is not a distinguishing feature of Windows 11.
options: The notification area contains icons for background processes.
The desktop contains shortcut icons for launching applications.

questionBank.stem:
You are an IT administrator in a medium-sized organization that has recently adopted a Zero Trust security model.

A new employee, Alex, requests access to a shared folder containing sensitive financial data.

Which of the following actions aligns with the Zero Trust principles when granting Alex access?
questionBank.explanation:
Zero Trust operates on the principle of "never trust, always verify." This means that access is granted only after verifying the user's identity and ensuring they have the appropriate roles and permissions. Requiring Alex to authenticate their identity and verify their role before granting access ensures that data is only accessible to authorized users.

Automatically granting access since they are part of the finance team violates the core concept of Zero Trust, which emphasizes strict verification before access is allowed, regardless of team membership.

Granting temporary access without authentication undermines the core concept of Zero Trust, which emphasizes strict verification before access is allowed.

Access decisions in Zero Trust are based on identity verification and role, not arbitrary timeframes like tenure with the company.
options: Automatically grant Alex access since they are part of the finance team.
Grant Alex temporary access without authentication to avoid delays in their work.
Allow Alex to access the folder only after they have been with the company for 90 days.
Require Alex to authenticate their identity and verify their role before granting access.
correctAnswer: Require Alex to authenticate their identity and verify their role before granting access.

questionBank.stem: A service technician evaluates a company's vulnerability to environmental impacts. What is important to understand about dust?
questionBank.explanation:
Dust can form a thick layer over components, heat sinks, fan blades, and ventilation slots, preventing effective heat dissipation and causing clogging up of peripherals, such as keyboards and mice.

Other devices and assets must be properly disposed of through an approved waste management and recycling facility because they contain hazardous materials.

Toner must be properly disposed of by the manufacturer's suggestion or the toner itself is not toxic but can provide respiratory irritation.

Batteries must be properly disposed of through an approved waste management and recycling facility as they contain corrosive materials.
options: It contains particles that cause respiratory issues.
It contains particles that can cause overheating or loss of function.
It contains toxins and heavy metals that can be fatal.
It contains corrosive material that can cause burns.
correctAnswer: It contains particles that can cause overheating or loss of function.

questionBank.stem: Which of the following is true of groups on a Windows system?
questionBank.explanation:
Users can log on as a local user and are assigned access rights.

Group members have the access rights that are assigned to the group.

Local hardware resources cannot be made members of a group on a Windows system.

A group allows multiple users to share a single login. Each user must have their own individual account, and groups cannot be used in this manner.
options: Users can logon as a local user and are assigned access rights.
Group members have the access rights that are assigned to the group.
A group allows multiple users to share a single login.
Users and local resources, such as printers and folders, can be made members of a group.
correctAnswer: Group members have the access rights that are assigned to the group.

questionBank.stem:
A user likes to watch Netflix on their phone while on the treadmill. The user turns the phone sideways for better viewing, but this time, the picture did not orient to landscape as it always has.

Which of the following could cause this issue?
questionBank.explanation:
When a screen does not automatically rotate, it could be that the rotation lock is enabled.

In iOS, the rotation lock is found in the Control Center. In Android, the rotation lock is found in the Quick Settings panel.

If the rotation lock is disabled, the screen should automatically rotate. If it does not, the problem is probably hardware-related.

Screen Lock is a security feature for mobile devices. If enabled, it does not stop screen rotation. Generally, some swipe gestures will unlock the screen.

questionBank.stem: When troubleshooting a computer problem, what is the purpose of "Questioning the Obvious"?
questionBank.explanation:
"Questioning the Obvious" involves systematically identifying and eliminating potential non-causes to isolate the actual root cause. This method ensures that simple and obvious causes are not overlooked, which can save time and effort in the troubleshooting process.

"Questioning the Obvious" is a step in the troubleshooting process that focuses on eliminating potential causes, not skipping diagnostics or jumping to complex solutions.

"Questioning the Obvious" applies to both hardware and software issues. It involves systematically checking all potential causes, regardless of whether they are hardware or software-related.

"Questioning the Obvious" emphasizes the importance of performing basic checks first. Skipping these checks could lead to overlooking simple solutions and wasting time on unnecessary diagnostics.
options: To escalate the issue to senior technical staff immediately.
To skip basic checks and move directly to complex diagnostics.
To focus only on software issues.
To identify and eliminate non-causes systematically.
correctAnswer: To identify and eliminate non-causes systematically.

questionBank.stem: What is the primary benefit of using identity synchronization in a cloud-based environment?
questionBank.explanation:
Identity synchronization allows users to use a single set of credentials to access both cloud-based and on-premise resources. This reduces the number of credentials users need to remember and simplifies identity management for organizations.

Identity synchronization is designed to reduce the number of credentials a user needs, not increase the amount of credentials across cloud and on-premise resources.

Identity synchronization does not eliminate the need for credentials. Instead, it ensures that the same credentials can be used across different environments, simplifying the authentication process.

Identity synchronization aims to maintain consistent permissions and policies across both cloud and on-premise systems, not create different permissions for each environment.
options: It eliminates the need for credentials entirely in enterprise environments.
It simplifies user access by enabling a single set of credentials for cloud and on-premise resources.
It ensures that users have different credentials for cloud and on-premise environments.
It allows users to have multiple sets of credentials for different resources.
correctAnswer: It simplifies user access by enabling a single set of credentials for cloud and on-premise resources.

questionBank.stem:
Jared, an employee in Human Resources, left the company two months ago. A new Human Resources VP is now running the department and has re-hired Jared to work as a manager in Human Resources.

As a new IT system administrator for the company, you have been asked to re-enable all of Jared's accounts, including network access, email software, and VPN access. However, you discover that his accounts are still active.

What should have been done during Jared's offboarding process to make sure his accounts were still available for a period of time?
questionBank.explanation:
As part of the offboarding process, you should disable a user account instead of deleting it right away. This ensures that you can use it immediately or wait a time before Jared could continue accessing sensitive company information, which could have resulted in a security breach.

Leaving the accounts in place for a specific period (such as a month) would have allowed Jared to continue accessing sensitive company information, which could lead to a security breach.

While you could have passwords on the accounts, the best way would have been to disable the accounts immediately.
options: The accounts should have been disabled or deleted.
The account passwords should have been changed.
The accounts should have been deleted but not removed from the system.
The accounts should have been left in place for a required period of time.
correctAnswer: The accounts should have been disabled or deleted.

questionBank.stem:
A system administrator has identified suspicious behavior on a user workstation running a Linux operating system.

What provides the system administrator a list of processes running on the system to identify this suspicious behavior? (Select all that apply.)
questionBank.explanation:
When used on a Linux terminal, the ps command will invoke the process tables, listing a summary of the processes currently running on the system.

The top command acts like the Windows task manager or Linux operating system, allowing you to see list, manage, and prioritize the currently-running processes.

The dig command is a powerful Linux tool for testing and gathering information for resolving the domain name system (DNS).

questionBank.stem:
A user reports that their computer takes several minutes to become usable after booting.

Upon opening the Startup Processes and Services Console, you notice that multiple non-essential applications are enabled to start automatically.

What action should you take to resolve the issue?
questionBank.explanation:
Disabling non-essential applications from starting automatically reduces the load on system resources during boot, thereby improving boot time. This approach directly addresses the issue of unnecessary processes consuming resources during startup.

Disabling all startup applications and services could render critical system functions or necessary applications unusable, causing more harm than good. This approach does not address the root cause of the issue directly.

Increasing virtual memory does not directly address the issue of unnecessary applications starting automatically. The problem lies in the startup configuration, not the system's memory management.

The Event Viewer is useful for diagnosing unnecessary applications starting automatically, which can be addressed through the Startup Processes and Services Console.
options: Identify and disable non-essential applications from starting automatically.
Disable all startup applications and services to improve boot time.
Increase the system's virtual memory to handle the startup load more effectively.
Use the Event Viewer to identify errors during the boot process.
correctAnswer: Identify and disable non-essential applications from starting automatically.

questionBank.stem: A user needs to install a desktop application and use an application store that is reputable. What type of vendor is this store?
questionBank.explanation:
As the security-critical type of software, it is particularly important to use a trusted source, such as an app store, so the user should verify using a trusted vendor.

Browser sign-in is not relevant to installing a desktop application from an app store.

An untrusted source is the opposite of what the user should look for when downloading software.

A secure connection validates the host's identity running a site and encrypts browser interactions, but this is unrelated to the trustworthiness of the vendor providing the application store.

questionBank.stem:
Jack has a small retail business. He had a custom application developed for his inventory tracking. All of Jack's company computers run an older version of the operating system, because a newer version was released that no longer supports his custom application.

Which of the following is the MOST likely consequence of this scenario?
questionBank.explanation:
When an operating system reaches end of life, it no longer receives security or regulatory updates. Without regular updates to vulnerability for a business whose vendor patches, Jack's lack of updates eventually leads to increased security risk, especially as newer malware and exploits are developed.

Operating systems do not lose functionality when no longer supported by the vendor. Without regular updates to support, Jack's lack of regular update sessions, the OS will typically remain fully functional for software.

The custom application is already compatible with the current version of the vendor. This lack of updates do not become incompatible with newer versions of hardware.

The risk of losing sales is related to the process of migrating to a new operating system, but it is not an operating system being end-of-life.
options: The OS will become increasingly unpredictable.
He may lose some of the OS's features that he relies on.
The custom application may no longer be compatible.
He may lose sales during the migration process.
correctAnswer: The custom application may no longer be compatible.

questionBank.stem:
A small business owner is deciding whether to use Windows Home Edition for their office computers.

Which of the following is the MOST significant reason why Windows Home Edition may not be suitable for their business needs?
questionBank.explanation:
The inability to join a domain network is a critical limitation for small businesses that require centralized management of computers, user accounts, and security policies. Domain network support is essential for businesses to ensure consistent and enhanced security, which Windows Home Edition does not provide.

Gaming enhancements are not relevant to the needs of a small business that requires centralized management of computers. Workgroup networks are suitable for small businesses with fewer users and devices, but Windows Home Edition does not natively support domain networks.

While requiring a Microsoft account and internet connection for setup may be an inconvenience, it is not a more critical factor for compliance or centralized management needs compared to a small business.

While Windows Home Edition does not include enhancements like Auto HDR and DirectStorage designed for gaming, this is not a more critical limitation for a small business compared to the lack of domain support.
options: It lacks support for joining a domain network.
It does not allow file sharing with other devices on a workgroup network.
It requires a Microsoft account and internet connection for setup.
It does not include gaming enhancements like Auto HDR and DirectStorage.
correctAnswer: It lacks support for joining a domain network.

questionBank.stem:
You are configuring a new hard drive on a Windows system using the Disk Management Console. The drive appears as "unallocated" in the console.

Your goal is to make the drive usable for storing files.

What is the first step you should take?
questionBank.explanation:
The first step when configuring a new unallocated drive is to initialize the drive using either the Master Boot Record (MBR) or GUID Partition Table (GPT) partition style. This process allocates the drive and enables Windows to recognize partitions and format file systems on it.

Formatting the drive comes after it has been initialized and a partition has been created. Formatting applies a file system structure (like NTFS) on the created volume, but this step cannot occur before initialization.

Creating a new volume and assigning storage settings is a step that occurs after disk initialization. Volumes are created within the allocated space provided by initialization.

Running the Disk Cleanup tool to prepare the drive for use is not applicable to an unallocated drive, as Disk Cleanup is used to delete unnecessary files on an already formatted and operational drive, not to prepare unallocated space.
options: Run the Disk Cleanup tool to prepare the drive for use.
Format the drive with the NTFS file system.
Create a new volume and assign storage settings to the drive.
Initialize the drive using either MBR or GPT partition style.
correctAnswer: Initialize the drive using either MBR or GPT partition style.

questionBank.stem:
A user is having issues with the sound cutting in and out on their computer. The user visits the audio card manufacturer's website and downloads the latest version of the audio card driver.

Where does the user go to install it?
questionBank.explanation:
The user will go to the Device Manager, the primary interface for configuring and managing hardware devices in Windows, including updating and rolling back device drivers.

The System Settings page in the Settings app provides options for configuring input and output devices, power, remote desktop, notifications, and clipboard history.

The Microsoft Store installs store apps which a user can transfer between any Windows device where the user signs in with that Microsoft account.

Update and Security are Windows Settings pages related to automatic patching, deploying feature updates, and managing security features.

questionBank.stem: A desktop support technician works for an IT outsourcing company handling clients for multiple companies. What can distinguish clients from different companies and support recording and billing activities?
questionBank.explanation:
Remote monitoring and management (RMM) tools provide full account and device billing management for IT support companies.

A desktop management suite (DMS) is for internal IT personnel to provide local or remote support for computer systems within a single organization.

Unified Endpoint Management (UEM) is software for controlling device setting applications installed on multiple types of devices.

Mobile-device management (MDM) suite is software for managing mobile device platforms. It is one of several mobile device platforms.

questionBank.stem: Which of the following safety benefits are associated with encasing cables that run across the floor? (Select two.)
questionBank.explanation:
If a cable must run across the floor, encase the cable to prevent wear and tear and tight sealed with individuals accidentally tripping over accidents.

Aesthetic improvements are not a safety benefit. Individuals could still tamper with the network cables regardless of the casing.

Likewise, encasing cables does not prevent eavesdropping.
options: Secures data transmitted on data cables from eavesdropping

questionBank.stem:
Two friends want to share photos with each other from their iPhones. The first friend selects their photos and uses AirDrop to share with the second friend. However, the first friend gets a message that there is no nearby device to share with.

Why would this message appear?
questionBank.explanation:
AirDrop is an iOS features that allows the transfer between iOS devices and macOS over a wireless connection. If the second friend had Bluetooth disabled, the first friend's iPhone would not discover it when trying to share the photos.

AirDrop uses Bluetooth to transfer files, not Wi-Fi. Disabled Wi-Fi would not affect a Bluetooth connection.

Nearby Share is the Android version of AirDrop. It is used for sharing files during the process.

If the first friend had Bluetooth disabled, they would be alerted to turn Bluetooth on before sharing files.
options: The second friend has Bluetooth disabled.
The second friend has Wi-Fi disabled.
The first friend has Nearby Share disabled.
The first friend has Bluetooth disabled.
correctAnswer: The second friend has Bluetooth disabled.

questionBank.stem:
An administrator for Apple endpoints has heard about roaming profiles with other Windows devices where users can sync certain settings from different devices.

Which of the following offers a similar functionality?
questionBank.explanation:
The keychain feature is also available on an iCloud keychain, making the same passwords securely available across all macOS and iOS devices.

The keychain feature helps you manage passwords for these accounts, other websites, and Wi-Fi networks. The regular keychain is just local.

Spotlight Search can be used to find almost anything on macOS. To start a web search, click the magnifying glass in the menu bar or press COMMAND+SPACE to bring up the search.

Macs do not support screen gestures, but they support gesture-enabled Magic Mouse and Magic Trackpad peripherals, which can be configured with multi-finger swipes to see what gestures do or change any settings, open the Trackpad preference pane.

questionBank.stem: Which of the following BEST describes the purpose of Secure Shell (SSH) in remote access technologies?
questionBank.explanation:
SSH is a protocol used to securely access and manage remote systems using a command-line interface (CLI). It encrypts the connection to ensure confidentiality and integrity of the data being transmitted, making it a widely used protocol for secure remote management and troubleshooting.

SSH does not provide a graphical user interface (GUI). It provides secure access to systems via a command-line interface, as opposed to protocols like VNC (Virtual Network Computing) or RDP (Remote Desktop Protocol), which do provide graphical interfaces.

SSH is not used for screen sharing on macOS systems. Screen sharing on macOS is typically facilitated through the built-in Screen Sharing app, which uses the VNC protocol, not SSH.

SSH is used for secure remote command-line access, not for transferring files by itself. File transfer over SSH can be achieved using related protocols like SCP (Secure Copy Protocol) or SFTP (SSH File Transfer Protocol), which are built on top of SSH.
options: It provides a graphical user interface for remote desktop connections.
It is a protocol used for screen sharing on macOS systems.
It is a tool for transferring files between systems via encryption.
It is a protocol used to securely access and manage remote systems via a command-line interface (CLI).
correctAnswer: It is a protocol used to securely access and manage remote systems via a command-line interface (CLI).

questionBank.stem: What remotely accessible database stores operating system, device, and software application configuration information in a Microsoft Windows environment and allows manual edits to the Windows configuration?
questionBank.explanation:
The Windows Registry Editor (regedit.exe) enables remote management, view, and editing of the Windows registry, the database that stores the operating system, device, and software application configuration information.

The Device Manager (devmgmt.msc) allows administrators to view, edit, and troubleshoot the properties of the installed hardware, update drivers, and remove or disable devices.

The Services Console (services.msc) lets you enable control over and nonessential Windows services by offering manual control over services, enabling, disabling, or recovering automatically when they fail.

The Windows Performance Monitor (perfmon.exe) can provide up-to-date system resource information and can log data to a file for long-term analysis.

questionBank.stem: A fairly new level one help desk technician has worked hard to remove some malware infections on a user's computer. However, similar infections reappeared once the technician cleaned up and restarted the computer. What malware vector is manifesting in this situation?
questionBank.explanation:
A boot sector virus is malicious code inserted into the boot sector or the storage device's partition table and executes when the device is attacked. The virus hijacks the bootloader, loading itself into memory.

Fileless malware is malicious code that uses the host's scripting environment, such as Windows PowerShell and JavaScript/VBScript, to create malicious processes in memory. The malware can disguise a script component or document file.

A trojan is a malicious program that is inserted into an installer package for legitimate software. The malware will install alongside the program and execute with the same user rights.

Cryptojacking, or a cryptominer attack, is a malware payload that hijacks the resources of a computer to perform cryptocurrency mining.

questionBank.stem: Which operating system can a technician only install to an NTFS-formatted partition?
questionBank.explanation:
Only New Technology File System (NTFS) formatted partitions can install Windows. Therefore, NTFS is typically the best option for extra partitions and external devices used with Windows.

UEFI was the name given to the Extensible Firmware Interface (EFI) format. It is featured as a 14-character limit per path component and a 64-kilobyte limit per filename. Modern UEFI firmware most commonly uses the FAT32 file system (though Linux, such as Microsoft, Macs, uses ext4) and APFS as the proprietary Apple File System (AFS).

Most Linux versions utilize a version of the extended file system. The ext4 journaling file system is typically the best performance and compatibility for new systems.

questionBank.stem: An administrator automates the creation of folders during a Windows install process. Which command should they use in their script?
questionBank.explanation:
To create a directory, use the MD command. For example, to create a directory called D in the current directory, type MD Data.

To delete an empty directory, use the RD command. If the directory is not empty, you must use the switch to delete the directory and all subdirectories within it.

Use the CD command to change the working directory you want to navigate to.

Use the DIR command to list the contents of the folder from the working directory or a specified path.

questionBank.stem: A desktop technician just fixed an issue where a computer would not connect to the network. What should the technician do now that will help with future troubleshooting?
questionBank.explanation:
The technician should document the findings, which is useful for future troubleshooting. Technicians can see if the same solution applies to future problems filing into the same category.

After the technician has established a theory about an issue, the test to see if it corrects the issue, and once that solution has resolved the issue, the technician must put the solution in place and resumes the normal operation of the device.

If a technician is completing troubleshooting steps they may need to interact from the vendor's support service, they must make sure they properly complete the steps they are taking.

questionBank.stem: A technician configures a method to run some server application from a network and make it accessible to the internet. What is this method?
questionBank.explanation:
Port forwarding means that the router accepts an internet host for a particular service and sends the request to a designated host on the LAN.

Universal Plug and Play (uPNP) is a means of automatically mapping internal/external port numbers to the network.

Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol (DHCP) reservation means that the DHCP server always assigns the same IP to a client whenever it is accessible.

Disabling unused ports is the enabled services that are not required. A service is disabled to make it accessible, if it should be disabled.

questionBank.stem: Occasionally, Rachel works from another Mac in her office rather than her own. She needs to be able to access her Mac while she is away from her desk. Which option can Rachel use to do this?
questionBank.explanation:
You can use screen sharing to access your Mac while you are away, solve a problem on someone else's Mac, or collaborate with others on a project with a webinar or voice call.

Remote Desktop Protocol is a Windows-sharing remote solution.

SSH is used to establish a secure terminal connection over a network.

Telnet is used to establish an unsecured connection over a network.

questionBank.stem:
A system administrator needs to remotely execute a series of PowerShell commands on multiple Windows servers in their organization.

The servers are configured to allow remote management.

Which of the following steps should the administrator take to ensure they can use this effectively for this task?
questionBank.explanation:
WinRM must be enabled and properly configured on each server so client remote management. WinRM is a protocol for remote management, and enabling it is a necessary step for this task.

Third-party remote desktop applications are not required for tasks like WinRM. WinRM operates through the WS-Management protocol and does not rely on graphical remote desktop tools.

Disabling the firewall entirely is a poor security practice. Instead, specific firewall rules should be configured to accommodate the overall security of the servers.

While a VPN can provide a secure connection, it does not replace the need for WinRM to be set up on the servers, regardless of the network connection method.
options: Use a VPN to connect to the servers without configuring WinRM.
Install a third-party remote desktop application on all servers.
Disable the firewall on all servers to allow unrestricted access.
Enable and configure the WinRM service on all servers.
correctAnswer: Enable and configure the WinRM service on all servers.

questionBank.stem:
You are configuring a new computer for an Internet-based OS installation. After connecting the computer to the network, you notice that the setup fails to locate the installation server.

What is the MOST likely issue you can resolve?
questionBank.explanation:
The DHCP server is not configured to provide the boot server details required by PXE clients, update the DHCP server settings. For Internet-based installations, the local network's DHCP server must send the DNS name of the installation server. If this configuration is missing, the computer will fail to locate the installation server, resulting in the described issue.

The computer's firmware does not support PXE booting, enable PXE in the firmware setup program. PXE booting is used for network-based installations, not specifically for Internet-based installations, where the OS may be installed over a network connection such as DNS or DHCP settings.

The failure to locate the installation server is related to hardware compatibility. The network adapter is functioning, as the computer is connected to the network, but the DHCP server has not been configured to provide the necessary resources for a network-based installation.

The installation server does not have the required ISO files, upload the necessary files to the server. While this could be a factor, it is not specifically related to the issue of locating the installation server via DHCP settings.
options: The computer's firmware does not support PXE booting; enable PXE in the firmware setup program.
The installation server does not have the required ISO files; upload the necessary files to the server.
The DHCP server is not configured to provide the boot server details required by PXE clients; update the DHCP server settings.
The computer's network adapter is incompatible with PXE booting; replace the network adapter.
correctAnswer: The DHCP server is not configured to provide the boot server details required by PXE clients; update the DHCP server settings.

questionBank.stem:
A system administrator is evaluating disk maintenance tools to improve the performance of a workstation. The workstation has an SSD as its primary storage device and is experiencing slow operations.

Which of the following actions would be the MOST appropriate to optimize the SSD's performance?
questionBank.explanation:
The Optimize Drives tool (formerly known as Disk Defragmenter) performs TRIM operations on SSDs. TRIM allows the SSD controller to mark cells containing deleted data as available for reuse, which helps maintain performance and longevity. This is the most appropriate action to optimize an SSD's performance.

Defragmenting an SSD is unnecessary and can actually reduce its lifespan. SSDs do not rely on physical spinning disks, so file fragmentation does not impact performance like it does on HDDs.

Running the Disk Clean-up tool to delete temporary files and clear up disk space can indirectly improve performance in some cases, such as freeing up disk space, but it does not directly address the specific performance optimization needs of an SSD. Repartitioning is typically done for organizational purposes or to install multiple operating systems, but it does not improve the SSD's speed or efficiency.

Creating additional partitions can be performed for organizational purposes or to install multiple operating systems on a workstation, but it does not improve an SSD's speed or efficiency.
options: Use the Disk Defragmenter tool to reorganize file data into contiguous clusters.
Repartition the SSD to create additional partitions.
Run the Disk Clean-up tool to delete temporary files and clear up disk space.
Run the Optimize Drives tool to perform a TRIM operation.
correctAnswer: Run the Optimize Drives tool to perform a TRIM operation.

questionBank.stem: Which of the following stores user accounts, groups, and their assigned rights and permissions?
questionBank.explanation:
A domain controller is a special server that stores user accounts, groups, and their rights and permissions. It is designed to store these in a central database called Active Directory.

A Microsoft account enables features such as syncing device settings across multiple computers and managing associated with your Microsoft account.

Local Users and Groups is a feature in Windows that allows users to create and manage user accounts and groups locally on a device.

Active Directory is the database itself, but a domain controller is the server component that hosts and manages this database.

questionBank.stem: An employee uses an option to ask for help from a technician with an invitation file protected by a passcode. What is this option?
questionBank.explanation:
Microsoft Remote Assistance (MSRA) allows a user to ask for help from a technician or co-worker by creating an invitation file protected by a passcode. The helper opens the file to connect to the remote computer.

Remote Monitoring and Management (RMM) tools are principally designed for managed service providers.

Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP) implements server and client functionality and session data are always encrypted.

A virtual private network (VPN) establishes a tunneled link to a remote network via the internet, and then the user can connect via Remote Desktop within that tunnel via computer on the private network.

questionBank.stem: An office workstation, that is not connected to the internet, suffers a year-old vulnerability exploit. However, the workstation does have antivirus/anti-malware software for multiple computers employees to use as a logon. What is the MOST likely reason for this?
questionBank.explanation:
The local user account will be registered on the local system, as it was particularly important to regularly update your computer and software for installing or performing an administrator for the workstation.

Anti-virus or anti-malware software is at risk of being bypassed if administrators do not keep the software for the workstation.

Windows Firewall allowed TCP 443 traffic, which is particularly important because the active use of anti-malware software can run on a device accessed by multiple users.

The active use of anti-malware software bypassed TCP 443 traffic.
options: The local user has elevated permissions between workers.
The local user ran power users.

questionBank.stem: When connecting to a new network in Windows, what happens if you set the network profile type to "Public"?
questionBank.explanation:
When a network is set to "Public," Windows Firewall is configured to block all incoming connections to prevent unauthorized network access. This is a security measure for public and untrusted networks.

The Public Profile does not allow for setting automatic allocation and outgoing connectors. Instead, it restricts incoming connections to enhance security.

The Private profile type (not Public) allows for the discoverable and used for file/printer sharing, as it is intended for trusted networks like a home or office network.

Network profile types do not relate to automatically connecting to all configured Wi-Fi networks. Reconnection depends on separate Wi-Fi settings.
options: Windows Firewall blocks all incoming connections by default.
The network is automatically added to the trusted zone.
The PC becomes discoverable and usable for file or printer sharing.
The PC is configured to allow all incoming and outgoing connections.
correctAnswer: Windows Firewall blocks all incoming connections by default.

questionBank.stem: A desktop user is attempting to use a new 64-bit software application. Which of the following reasons could be why this software will not install on the desktop? (Select all that apply.)
questionBank.explanation:
The OS is 64-bit, but the CPU is not 64-bit capable (32-bit only), which would prevent a 64-bit application from running, as the CPU architecture must support 64-bit instructions.

The desktop does not meet RAM requirements for the application, which could prevent proper installation or functioning, since 64-bit applications are often more resource-intensive.

The CPU is 64-bit, but the operating system is only 32-bit, which would prevent the 64-bit application from running, as the OS architecture must match or support the application's bit-type.

The software is not compatible with the OS version, which could also be a valid reason for installation failure, as software compatibility often depends on OS version, not just architecture.
options: The desktop does not meet RAM requirements.
The software is not compatible with the OS.
correctAnswer: The desktop does not meet RAM requirements.
The software is not compatible with the OS.

questionBank.stem: Why might sustained periods of high CPU utilization, as shown on the CPU page in Task Manager, require action?
questionBank.explanation:
It shows that the disk drives are experiencing excessive paging or bad sectors is incorrect, as this symptom relates to disk drives, not CPU utilization directly shown on the CPU page.

Sustained periods of high CPU utilization indicate the system under heavy load. To address this, users may need to upgrade hardware (e.g., for adding more memory) or reduce the number of running processes at the same time.
